en.title: Peter Cullen's Final Optimus Prime Performance Arrives with 'Awakening'
en.summary: The voice of a generation bids farewell as Peter Cullen's last performance as Optimus Prime premieres in 'Optimus Prime: Awakening'. This poignant short film celebrates the 40th anniversary of Transformers: The Movie and honors a legendary career.
en.body:
The roar of **Optimus Prime** will forever echo in the hearts of fans, but a new era has dawned with the premiere of **'Optimus Prime: Awakening'**. This special short film, released as part of the 40th anniversary of **Transformers: The Movie**, features the *final* performance of the legendary **Peter Cullen** as the beloved Autobot leader. For over four decades, Cullen's voice has been synonymous with courage, sacrifice, and unwavering leadership, making him an integral part of the Transformers legacy. His passing on August 26, 2026, marked the end of an era, but 'Awakening' offers a powerful, albeit bittersweet, tribute to his unparalleled contribution.

Filmmaker **Joshua Wassung**, known for his work on **Predator: Killer of Killers**, helmed this special project. Speaking at a special screening event, Wassung detailed the emotional weight of bringing this final chapter to life. The short film is not merely a bonus feature; it's a heartfelt send-off, a chance for fans worldwide to collectively acknowledge the immense impact Cullen had on their childhoods and beyond. His brother, a Marine veteran, once shared advice with Cullen that shaped Optimus Prime's compassionate authority, a testament to the real-world inspiration behind the character's iconic persona. This final performance ensures that Cullen's spirit, embodied by the Autobot leader, will continue to inspire for generations to come.

## A Farewell to a Legend
The premiere of **'Optimus Prime: Awakening'** has resonated deeply within the Transformers fandom, serving as a powerful moment of remembrance. For many, **Peter Cullen** wasn't just a voice actor; he was the very soul of **Optimus Prime**. The news of his passing earlier this year left a void, but this short film provides a tangible way to celebrate his enduring legacy. Fans have taken to social media to share their emotional reactions, calling the short a fitting and poignant goodbye to the man who gave a mechanical hero such profound humanity. It’s a collective moment of gratitude for the countless hours of inspiration and adventure he provided.

## What's Next for the Autobots
**'Optimus Prime: Awakening'** is now available on YouTube as of September 9, allowing fans globally to experience **Peter Cullen**'s final turn as the iconic leader. While this marks the end of an era for the voice of **Optimus Prime**, the spirit of the Autobots continues. Further details on upcoming Transformers projects and how the franchise will honor **Peter Cullen**'s memory are expected to be announced.

content_raw: As part of the 40th anniversary celebration of Transformers: The Movie , Collider was honored to partner with Hasbro and Fathom Entertainment to invite LA fans to an advanced screening of the re-release, plus a sneak peek screening of the after-credits short, Optimus Prime: Awakening . The short film is helmed by filmmaker Joshua Wassung ( Predator: Killer of Killers ), who joined us on stage afterwards for a discussion about how Awakening came to be, and to honor the late and legendary Peter Cullen , who provided the voice of Optimus Prime for four decades.
